items: Pay for legal services through the platform only, and never pay a lawyer outside it.
Report it to the platform right away if a lawyer asks me to pay or communicate outside it.
Understand that the platform bears no responsibility for payments or agreements made outside it.
Not share or ask for personal contact details with a lawyer outside the platform.
Contact the support team with any question or problem.
